title: Shiu AI Paper Trading Results: +$7,403 P&L in 30 Days
author: AdhesivenessNo1241
selftext:
Mods, delete if not allowed, but Reddit recommended I share this here.

The AI uses a multi-tier confirmation process to eliminate emotion and bad entries. It scans 15m momentum, CVD trends, order-book flow, and ATR chop thresholds across 5 trading modes (Momentum, Retest, Reversal, Sweep & Reclaim, AI).

If conviction scores, directional gates, and liquidity rules aren't 100% aligned, it sits on ⁠NO\_SETUP⁠ and waits. That strict discipline is exactly how the 81% win rate is achieved.

comments.author: fluffymeowmeowkitty

replies.author: AdhesivenessNo1241
replies.body:
Check the built-in pre-trade filters in SHIU AI trade tab. Filter F5 (News Calendar) automatically halts execution during high-impact macro news events, while strict gates like RUNWAY\_INSUFFICIENT block trades if there isn't guaranteed clearance—even over a tiny $21 difference ($279 vs $300 required).

The system doesn't gamble through black-swan macro events or tariff dumps. It filters them out, stays on ⁠NO\_SETUP⁠, and waits for high-probability flow. That's how capital gets protected.

replies.body: It operates as a real-time simulation of live market data. You can watch the paper trade results play out, copy them over to a real exchange, and monitor them yourself, I’ve done it, and the results align consistently because it tracks real market behavior directly.

replies.author: AdhesivenessNo1241
replies.body: The model itself is trained using 30x parameters, but you can copy and execute the trades on any platform using 30x leverage or lower, whatever risk level you're comfortable managing while watching the setups play out.

replies.author: AdhesivenessNo1241
replies.body:
You're misunderstanding who is paying what.  
When I said "a small fee to pay," I meant the fee I pay as the developer to access the live market data feeds and run the AI infrastructure behind the scenes.

Users do not pay for the AI usage or data feeds, it is completely free for you to use.

I pay those data/AI costs myself because I trade off the signals directly, and I easily recoup my overhead by taking trades with confidence instead of guessing. Since the system is already built and running for my own trading, I made the web app free so anyone else can copy the trades if they want to.

In saying that, I might put on a subscription down the line if I feel there are too many freeloaders overloading the server.
